title: BALLSCRAFT
description: Experience an entirely overhauled Minecraft experience, with 100s of new items, structures and biomes!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71287e0cd03389dafc7be8d04609c3fa0bd8ed69.png)
Get ready for the ULTIMATE Minecraft modded experience with BALLSCRAFT!

This modpack features over 100 mods which add 100s of new biomes, items, tools and weapons, building blocks and structures! There actually might be over 1,000 structures...

Custom main menu makes the modpack really stand out from vanilla Minecraft!
![Custom Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1eda6adae9ab76712dc7e38b79ae6177ca8b0e85.jpeg)

There are plenty of performance boosting mods, such as Sodium to keep your experience as smooth as a bald head!

Now go ahead and download this modpack for the best Minecraft experience of your life!

Don't forget to join [our discord server!](https://discord.gg/jC6RN6RT4P)!

If you're still here I'll just tell you, there are guns too.
